question: Army men who are rescued from insurgent kidnap undergo medical check-up. Why is this done?
options: To protect the prisoner from further harassment
To avoid relapses from illness while in hiding
To determine the physical and mental state of the army man
To determine the loyalty of this army man
correctAnswer: To determine the physical and mental state of the army man

question: Miss Victoria has many children. Her husband decided to send them to Manila and seek jobs. The eldest child is only 16 years old. What right is violated by the father?
options: Right of family to family living wage
Right to education

correctAnswer: Right of the children to assistance, proper care and attention

question: A prisoner was made to confess his guilt. A lawyer of the respondent was present in the confession. What was violated?
options: The confession was without due consultant

correctAnswer: The prisoner should have a lawyer of his choice

question: When do doctors declare dengue fever as an epidemic?
options: When everyone is suffering from a cold
When two are hospitalized from the neighborhood

correctAnswer: When the proportion of patients reach at least 15% of the population
